en.blurb_baron: %{name} is the Baron of %{clan}Clan. The Baron makes all decisions for their people and is solely responsible for keeping things running smoothly.
en.blurb_regent: %{name} is %{clan}Clan's regent. The Regent is the head of all Clippers, and the Baron's first line of defense.
en.blurb_heir: %{name} is the heir to the Barony. The heir is chosen by the Baron to take over the throne upon the Baron's death. Instead of being trained solely in fighting or hunting, the heir is raised and taught the political intricacies of Baronship. Heirs are typically direct descendants of their Baron, but this custom is not always followed.
en.blurb_clipper: %{name} is a Clipper. Clippers are cats trained to defend their Baron, even at the cost of their life. They're skilled in deadly battle moves and report to the Regent.
en.blurb_elder: %{name} is an elder. They have spent many moons serving their Clan, and have earned many moons of rest. Elders are essential to passing down the oral tradition of the Clan. Sometimes, cats may retire due to disability or injury. Whatever the circumstance of their retirement, elders are held in high esteem in the Clan and always eat before clippers and doctors.
en.blurb_doctor: %{name} is a doctor. Doctors take care of the cats in the Barony. They are not expected to hunt like cogs or fight like Clippers. They are well-respected and very knowledgeable.
en.blurb_cog: %{name} is a cog. Cogs work for their Barons by gathering prey and supplies. They are not trained to fight or heal. Every cat is destined to grow up as a cog unless chosen as a colt or born as an heir.
en.blurb_apprentice: %{name} is a colt. Cogs or kittens can be chosen as colts from six moons of age, when they are then trained by Clippers to defend the Baron with their claws. Colts have special bonds with their Clippers, being trained exclusively by them.
en.blurb_apprentice_doctor: %{name} is an apprentice doctor, training to become a full doctor. Kittens can be made apprentice doctors at six moons of age, where they will learn how to heal.
en.blurb_kitten: %{name} is a kitten. All cats below the age of six moons are considered kits. Kits are prohibited from leaving camp in order to protect them from the dangers of the Badlands. Although they don't have any official duties, they are expected to learn the legends and traditions of their Clan. They are protected by every cat in the Clan and always eat first.
en.blurb_newborn: %{name} is a newborn kitten. All cats below the age of six moons are considered kits. Kits are prohibited from leaving camp in order to protect them from the dangers of the wild. Although they don't have any official duties, they are expected to learn the legends and traditions of their Clan. They are protected by every cat in the Clan and always eat first.
en.blurb_unknown: %{name} has an unknown rank. I guess they want to make their own way in life!
